svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

svg.text: Make one pawl (+Y side) and one catch (-Y side), mirror images.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pawl plate: 12 mm, 24 wide, 90 between the shaft and the tip

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centre, round ends of 12 radius; weld on the shaft's inner end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Handle: 10 mm plate 20 wide, from the shaft out to a 20 knob,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: welded on the shaft's outer end, outside the bracket plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: shaft through the 16.5 hole in the bracket plate, washer

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and circlip; a torsion spring holds the tip against the crank pin.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pawl: its tip drops in under the crank pin at the end of the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: stroke and takes the kickback end on, along its length.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Catch: its tip drops in above the crank pin at the start and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: stops the lever falling into the stroke.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: each snaps in by its spring and lifts out by the handle.
